description: A faint, rectilinear north–south trending linear depression approximately 180 m in length, appearing as a shallow ditch with consistent width (~2–3 m) visible in the DTM hillshade and curvature filters. It exhibits slight negative plan curvature and aligns closely with vegetation-moisture anomalies in the NIR composite.

An east–west oriented low embankment or berm, about 140 m long and 2–4 m wide, intersecting anomaly_1 near its midpoint. This feature shows subtle convex curvature in the DTM and a coincident low-reflectance corridor in the NIR band, suggesting moisture retention or an organic-rich substrate.
